battle.name: 壽州之戰
battle.brief: 顯德二年起，後周世宗柴榮三度親征淮南，圍攻南唐重鎮壽州近三年；守將劉仁贍死守孤城，後周最終靠飛石砲、雲梯與穿甲箭破城。卡面這件斯巴達長矛所代表的兩米木槍加金屬槍尾，正是壽州城頭拒馬列陣所用長柄兵器的原型。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰一方是後周。柴榮於顯德元年即位後重整軍制，以殿前都點檢趙匡胤領殿前司，樞密使李重進、張永德等分掌淮南方向兵權，各道另置招討使、節度使統兵，禁軍分殿前司與殿後司兩部，步軍以長槊與弩手為骨幹，騎軍為世宗所重，糧道則由汴京沿蔡水、淮水一路東下。後周自居中國正統，視南唐為割據偽朝，出兵的表面理由是南唐侵奪淮南、拒絕交出州縣。另一方是南唐，即李氏建都金陵的淮南國，中主李璟以中書省與樞密院分掌政事，樞密使李景達總軍政，壽州由劉仁贍鎮守，池州朱令、濠州等處各置守將，江淮之間另備舟師。吳越國錢氏奉後周之命出兵策應，北方北漢則與南唐暗通款曲，使後周不能傾國力專攻淮南。三方糾纏之下，這場圍城戰既是攻城技術與糧道運作的較量，也是中原正統與江南割據之間的實力試煉。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Later Zhou. After Chai Rong took the throne in 954 the court rebuilt its field forces: Zhao Kuangyin, as diandian dudianjian, commanded the Palace Guards, while the chancellor Li Chongjin, Zhang Yongde and others directed the armies sent into Huainan, with zhaotaoshi and jiedushi raising men from the individual circuits. The infantry rested on long spears and crossbowmen, the cavalry was the emperor's particular concern, and grain travelled east from Bianjing along the Cai and Huai waterways. Later Zhou claimed the orthodox succession of the central states and treated Southern Tang as a separatist pseudo-dynasty; the overt reason for the war was that Southern Tang had seized Huainan and refused to surrender the occupied prefectures. The other side was Southern Tang, the Li-ruled state with its capital at Jinling, where the Secretariat and the Bureau of Military Affairs divided civil and military authority, the military commissioner Li Jingda supervised the armed forces, Liu Renshan held Shouzhou, Zhu Ling sat at Chizhou, and river squadrons covered the Han and the Huai. The king of Wuyue, Qian Hongchu, sent troops and tribute to assist Later Zhou, while Northern Han in the north kept up secret contacts with Southern Tang, so Later Zhou could never commit its whole strength to Huainan. In this three-way entanglement the siege became both a trial of siegecraft and grain transport and a test of strength between the northern court and the Jiangnan regime.
people: 後周世宗柴榮是全役的樞紐。他三次親征淮南：頭一回屯兵正陽一帶，攻城一再不成，諸將受到貶處，他憤而班師北還；第二回再南下，趙匡胤攻滁州，南唐援帥朱令自池州率大軍北上，在皖地一帶被擊破，朱令死於亂軍，首級傳到壽州城下，守軍為之氣奪；第三回柴榮親至壽州城下督造攻城器械，終於破城。李重進以樞密使身份統淮南諸軍，多次出擊正陽、濠州；張永德、曹彬等分道出擊，吳越王錢弘俶遣使奉上方物助陣。南唐方面，壽州守將劉仁贍是全城的主心骨：城破被俘，他慷慨陳詞不屈，柴榮親自撫慰授官，惜其不久病卒於京師。李景達以樞密使領十五萬水軍北上，欲解金陵之危，敗於紫金山；李璟又毒殺弟齊王李景遂，兄弟互疑，國勢益衰。南唐宰相邊鎬等奉命議和，以割地稱臣換取罷兵。此役勝負幾乎全繫在柴榮與劉仁贍兩人的對峙上：一人代表進攻方的組織力與器械優勢，一人代表守方的死守與榮譽。
peopleEn: Emperor Shizong Chai Rong of Later Zhou was the pivot of the whole campaign. He led three personal campaigns into Huainan. On the first he sat before Zhengyang; the siege would not take, the generals were punished, and he went back north in anger. On the second he came south again, Zhao Kuangyin stormed Chuzhou, and Zhu Ling, the Southern Tang relief commander, marched north from Chizhou with a great host and was destroyed in the region of modern Anhui; Zhu Ling was killed, and his head was carried to the foot of Shouzhou, which broke the morale of the garrison. On the third Chai Rong himself stood beneath the walls of Shouzhou, supervised the building of siege engines, and took the city. Li Chongjin, as chancellor, directed the Huainan armies and struck at Zhengyang and Haozhou again and again; Zhang Yongde and Cao Bin operated on separate lines, and the king of Wuyue, Qian Hongchu, sent envoys with local products to encourage the besiegers. On the Southern Tang side, the garrison commander Liu Renshan was the heart of the defence: taken alive when the wall fell, he stated his case without yielding; Chai Rong received him with his own hands and gave him office, and he died of illness in the capital shortly after. Li Jingda, the military commissioner, led a fleet said to number 150,000 men north to relieve Jinling and was beaten at Zijin Mountain; Li Jing then poisoned his brother the Prince of Qi, and suspicion between the royal brothers destroyed what confidence the state still had. Southern Tang ministers such as Bian Gao were sent to negotiate, buying the end of the war with ceded land and an oath of fealty. The outcome turned on the duel between two men: Chai Rong, embodying the organiser's will and the new engines of war, and Liu Renshan, embodying the stubbornness and the honour of the defender.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛，即Dory，約兩米長的直木槍，槍身取白蠟木或山毛櫸削製，槍頭為寬闊的葉形金屬矛刃，槍尾另裝金屬套筒，既可在格擋時當作配重，也能在列陣時把槍尾插進土裡固定陣腳。槍尾帶銅套，正是這件兵器的辨認要點，也是它能在方陣裡站住腳的原因。壽州之戰的戰場上沒有希臘人，但同一類兵器卻到處都是：南唐守軍在城頭列長槊與標槍，前排以大盾、拒馬遮住垛口，後排用弓弩壓制城下的雲梯；後周步軍以長槊居前列，弩手、弓箭手殿後，等雲梯靠牆才結成長槍縱隊突入，用密集的槍尖頂住守軍砸下的檑木礫石。圍城兩年多，真正能左右勝負的是攻城與守城的器械：攻城一方有飛石、砲、雲梯、穿甲箭與新造的攻城塔，守方有弩、檑木、礫石、拒馬與厚重的城牆本身。斯巴達長矛本身並未出現在壽州，但它所代表的那一類兩米木槍加金屬槍尾，在這場戰役裡同時是守城的骨幹與反擊的骨幹，角色恰似方陣中的Dory：靠整齊的排列與統一的步調，把零散的勇力凝成一道牆。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory: a straight shaft about two metres long, whittled from ash or beech, carrying a broad leaf-shaped metal head and, at the other end, a metal butt cap. That cap let a warrior use the weapon as a brace, plant it in the ground, and hold his place in the line; the copper-shod butt is the dory's signature feature and the reason it could stand in a phalanx. No Greek set foot at Shouzhou, but weapons of exactly that family were everywhere on the field. The Southern Tang garrison arrayed long spears and javelins along the wall, with large shields and spiked barriers masking the crenellations in front and crossbowmen behind covering the ladders against the wall; the Later Zhou infantry kept the long spears in the first rank with crossbow and bowmen behind them, and only closed into a spear column once the ladders were fixed, meeting the logs and stones thrown down from the ramparts with a dense hedge of points. What decided the siege was the artillery on both sides: for the besiegers, stone-throwers, cannon, scaling ladders, armour-piercing arrows and newly built siege towers; for the defenders, crossbows, rolling logs, stones, spiked barriers and the thickness of the wall itself. The dory itself never fought at Shouzhou, but the weapon type it stands for, a two-metre wooden shaft with a metal-shod butt, was at once the backbone of the defence and the backbone of the counterattack, playing there exactly the role it played in the Greek phalanx: by sheer order and common step, turning individual bravery into a wall.
tactics: 壽州依淮水而建，外有濠溝，牆高而厚，甕城環繞，攻城極難。後周最初以大軍正面強攻，架雲梯、填壕、攀牆，屢攻不克，傷亡累累，遂改為先絕糧道、再以長圍困之：分兵掃清城周村鎮，斷絕樵采、斷絕援路，把攻城變成飢餓與器械的比賽。柴榮親至城下後，命軍中製造飛石與砲，專射城頭守軍與城樓，又大量製作穿甲箭，射穿守軍的皮甲木盾，試圖在城牆上打開缺口。守方則以弩箭、檑木、礫石招呼城下密集的隊形，並趁後周兵疲、夜間或暴雨時出城燒毀攻城器械、襲擊糧隊，壽州守軍多次派敢死隊夜襲反制，把圍城拖成長期的消耗。最後破城的，是一次總攻配合新造的攻城器械。史載有限，攻城器械的具體形制、施放方式與數量，諸家記載互有出入，所可確定的是：遠程投射、重點破壞城樓、斷糧與夜襲對抗同時使用，而城頭的長槊與拒馬陣始終是最後一道防線，攻方真正要解決的，是如何在飛石與穿甲箭之下維持住雲梯前沿的縱隊不散。
tacticsEn: Shouzhou was built against the Huai: a moat outside, high and thick walls, and a ring of barbican works, so that taking it was extremely hard. Later Zhou at first assaulted head-on with massed troops, scaling ladders, filled ditches and scrambling up the walls; the assaults failed repeatedly and cost heavily, so the command changed to strangling the city first, cutting its supply line, and then besieging it at length. Detachments swept the villages around the walls, shutting off firewood and relief, turning the siege into a contest between hunger and siege engines. Once Chai Rong was under the walls he had the army build stone-throwers and cannon to smash the defenders and the wall towers, and he had large numbers of armour-piercing arrows made to punch through leather and wooden shields, hoping to open a breach. The defenders answered the dense formations below with crossbow bolts, rolling logs and stones, and whenever the besieging troops were tired, or at night, or in heavy rain, they sallied out to burn the engines and strike the grain convoys; the garrison of Shouzhou sent out daredevil night raids of its own and dragged the siege out into a war of attrition. The wall finally fell under a general assault supported by newly built engines. The record is thin here, and the exact form, the method of discharge and the number of the engines are reported differently by the various historians; what can be said with confidence is that long-range projection, deliberate destruction of the wall towers, cutting of supplies and night counter-raids were all used at once, while the spears and spiked barriers of the rampart remained the last line of defence, and the real problem for the attackers was how to keep the ladder-head columns from disintegrating under stone-throwers and armour-piercing arrows.
data: 壽州之戰可核的數字並不多，且多為概數。《資治通鑑》記南唐援將朱令自池州北上的兵眾為七萬，記李景達在紫金山與趙匡胤對峙時所領水軍為十五萬；劉仁贍入壽州時所部兵眾，諸史概稱萬餘，城中另有隨軍丁口數萬。圍城自顯德二年南唐兵進取淮南算起，到顯德五年壽州陷落，前後歷時近三年，其中合圍作戰約兩年，柴榮親征三次。後周方面的出動兵員，《宋史》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下可核的總數，只稱傾力以出；攻城器械也只留下方向性的記載，提到飛石、砲、雲梯、穿甲箭與自造的攻城塔一類的東西。距離方面，壽州至金陵約二百餘里水路，至汴京則逾千里，糧運全賴淮水與汴渠，沿途還要護衛漕船。史家因此常說，此役勝負不在兵力而在糧道與器械；從圍城歷時長、破城又出在最後一季來看，這一說法頗為吻合。至於守軍究竟在城頭頂住過多少次進攻、器械損耗幾何、各家記載零散，諸說並存，不宜徑取其一。
dataEn: Few verifiable figures survive for the siege of Shouzhou, and most are round numbers. The Zizhi Tongjian records that the Southern Tang relief commander Zhu Ling led seventy thousand men north from Chizhou, and that Li Jingda brought a fleet of one hundred and fifty thousand men against Zhao Kuangyin at Zijin Mountain. For Liu Renshan, the historiographers say only that he entered Shouzhou with something over ten thousand men, while several tens of thousands of dependants were inside the walls with them. From the moment Southern Tang troops pushed into Huainan in the second year of Xiande until the fall of Shouzhou in the fifth, the whole affair lasted close to three years, of which about two were spent in active siege, and Chai Rong led three personal campaigns. The size of the Later Zhou host is nowhere given as a checkable total; the Song History and the Tongjian say only that everything was put into it, and the siege engines are recorded only in outline, with mention of stone-throwers, cannon, scaling ladders, armour-piercing arrows and purpose-built siege towers. As for distances, Shouzhou lies a little over two hundred li of water from Jinling and more than a thousand li from Bianjing, and every grain shipment moved by the Huai and the Bian channels under escort. Hence the common judgement of the historians that the issue was decided not by numbers of men but by supply line and engineering; the length of the siege and the fact that the wall fell in the last season of the campaign both fit that reading. How many separate assaults the garrison actually turned back on the wall, and how much equipment was lost, are scattered and contradictory, and no single version should be taken as settled.
cause: 壽州之戰的直接起因是南唐對淮南的進取。柴榮即位之初，後周內部仍在整軍備戰，南唐中主李璟卻趁中原多事，遣使索取淮南州縣，兵鋒直指壽春一帶，逼近後周的漕運線與宿衞重地。壽州當淮水要衝，西通蔡州，東連淮南，下達濠泗，上控汴蔡，誰佔了壽州，誰就握住淮河中游的樞紐；它又是南唐北上與西北兩路防守的交會點。後周據報南唐兵已入淮南，詔令各道整軍備禦，柴榮並詔吳越出兵策應，同時遣使交涉責問。南唐主不願就此退兵，反而加派兵將、增修城防，把壽州變成南唐伸入淮北的前哨堡壘。此戰因此不是偶發的邊界衝突，而是後周打算以新王朝的力量整頓淮南、消除南唐北進勢頭的一次有意的軍事行動；南唐把壽州當作必守之地，也正因為明白此城一失，淮河防線便會整體退到長江兩岸，江南再無可伸展之地。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the siege of Shouzhou was Southern Tang's advance into Huainan. In the first years of Chai Rong's reign the Later Zhou was still reorganising and arming itself, while the Southern Tang ruler Li Jing took advantage of the troubles in the central plains and sent envoys to demand the Huainan prefectures, pushing troops towards Shouchun and towards the Later Zhou's grain route and garrisoning grounds. Shouzhou commands the Huai: west to Caizhou, east into Huainan, downstream to Haozhou and Sizhou, upstream towards Bian and Cai. Whoever holds Shouzhou holds the hinge of the middle Huai, and for Southern Tang it was also the meeting point of the northern and north-western defences. When the Later Zhou learned that Southern Tang troops had entered Huainan, it ordered the circuits to mobilise, summoned Wuyue to move in support, and sent envoys to reproach the southern court. Li Jing would not withdraw; he reinforced the garrison and repaired the walls, turning Shouzhou into a forward bastion planted in the north of the Huai. The war was therefore no accidental border clash, but a deliberate operation by the new dynasty to reorder Huainan and break Southern Tang's northern momentum, and Southern Tang fought to hold the city precisely because it understood that once Shouzhou fell the whole Huai line would retreat to the banks of the Yangtze and the south would have nowhere left to expand.
impact: 壽州之戰的結果，是南唐在淮南的北進計劃被徹底打散。壽州陷落之後，同年冬李景達的水軍在紫金山一戰崩潰，金陵門戶洞開，李璟被迫遣使稱臣、割地納貢；次年顯德六年，柴榮再度出征淮南，南唐失地更多，長江以北盡歸中原。壽州一役也把柴榮的威望推到極點：後周禁軍在三次親征中越戰越強，趙匡胤、李重進、張永德、曹彬等分路名將在此役中累積資歷，其中趙匡胤更憑壽州以及其後攻滁州、揚州、泰州、六合的戰績，穩坐禁軍統帥之位，五年後陳橋兵變、建立宋朝，班底正是壽州與淮南一役鍛成的那一批將領。南唐方面，劉仁贍死守壽州的事跡，成為此後兩宋兵書中最常被引用的守城典範：以孤城抗大軍、以攻待援，寧死不屈。對後世而言，這場戰爭標誌著唐末以來長江南北的均勢徹底傾斜，統一已由五代的割據聯盟局面，轉為北方新王朝可以持續推進的日程。
impactEn: The result of the siege of Shouzhou was the complete dispersal of Southern Tang's northern offensive in Huainan. After the city fell, the Southern Tang fleet under Li Jingda was crushed at Zijin Mountain that same winter, the gates of Jinling stood open, and Li Jing was compelled to send envoys to acknowledge his submission, cede land and pay tribute. The following year, in the sixth year of Xiande, Chai Rong campaigned into Huainan again and took more territory, leaving the north of the Yangtze entirely in central plains hands. The war also carried Chai Rong's prestige to its peak: the Later Zhou guard grew stronger with every personal campaign, and commanders such as Zhao Kuangyin, Li Chongjin, Zhang Yongde and Cao Bin built their reputations here. Zhao Kuangyin in particular, on the strength of Shouzhou and of his later sieges of Chuzhou, Yangzhou, Taizhou and Liuhe, took his place as master of the imperial army, and the officer corps that broke the ground at Chenqiao five years later and founded the Song dynasty was the one forged in Huainan. On the Southern Tang side, the defence of Shouzhou by Liu Renshan became the most frequently quoted model of holding a city in the military manuals of the two later Song: a single city against an army, attack answering attack, and no surrender. For posterity the war marked the final tilt of the balance between north and south that had held since the late Tang; unification passed from the patchwork of Five Dynasties alliances to a programme the new northern dynasty could keep advancing.
result: 壽州城在顯德五年被後周攻破，拖了近三年而未能早破的守軍終於潰散，劉仁贍被生擒，講明城破之由與不屈之志，柴榮沒有加罪，反授以官職，惜其不久病卒。破城之後，南唐再無可用之兵抵禦北方攻勢：同年南唐水軍在紫金山潰敗，李璟只能上表稱臣，割沿淮州縣，進納歲貢。後周取得壽州及淮北要道，淮南屏障盡入其手，其後顯德六年再伐，南唐失地愈廣。從大的格局看，此役之後唐末以來數十年的南北分立已見終局，柴榮雖次年病逝、趙匡胤隨即代周，仍然接手了一個只需收拾殘局的江南。史載此役的細節多有出入，尤其兵員數、器械細目與城破的確切日子，各家史書說法不同；較可確定的是，壽州以一座城池拖住後周主力近三年，終因攻城技術的進步與糧道戰略的成熟而陷落。
resultEn: Shouzhou was stormed by Later Zhou in the fifth year of Xiande. The garrison that had held the city for close to three years finally broke, and Liu Renshan was taken alive. He set out the reasons the wall had fallen and refused to submit, and Chai Rong did not punish him but gave him office instead, mourning him when he died of illness soon afterwards. Once the city was taken, Southern Tang had no force left to resist a northern offensive: in the same year its fleet was destroyed at Zijin Mountain, and Li Jing could only present a memorial of submission, cede the prefectures along the Huai and pay his regular tribute. Later Zhou gained Shouzhou and the key positions north of the Huai, and the screen protecting Huainan fell entirely into its hands; the campaign of the sixth year of Xiande took still more ground for the north. In the larger pattern, the decades of north-south division that had lasted since the late Tang drew to an end after this war. Chai Rong died the following year and Zhao Kuangyin immediately replaced the Zhou, yet the Song inherited a south that was already reduced to a matter of mopping up. The details of the siege are reported inconsistently, above all the numbers of men, the particulars of the engines and the exact day the wall fell, but what can be said with confidence is that a single city held the main Later Zhou army at bay for nearly three years and fell only when improved siegecraft and a matured strategy of cutting the grain line had done their work.
